description: This file defines the TaskDatabase class for managing task data using SQLite in a Flutter app. It includes methods for database initialization, CRUD operations, and querying tasks by list name.

classes.name: TaskDatabase
classes.description: A singleton class providing database access and CRUD operations for task data.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns the database instance.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database with the specified file path.

methods.name: _createDB
methods.description: Creates the tasks table with specified schema.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the database.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID.

methods.name: readAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the database.

methods.name: readSpecificTasks
methods.description: Retrieves tasks filtered by list name.
